question: Chhath Puja is the main festival of which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Chhath Puja is a significant festival dedicated to the Sun God (Surya) and Chhathi Maiya.
 
• It is predominantly celebrated in the Indian state of Bihar, along with Jharkhand, Eastern Uttar Pradesh, and the Madhesh region of Nepal.
 
• The festival involves rigorous rituals including holy bathing, fasting, and abstaining from drinking water (vrata), standing in water for long periods, and offering
